properties.description:
Introduce reusable IconButtonGroup composition in RelationalUi for related clickable actions. Match the visual grouping approach of IconRadioButton, without mutually exclusive selection or radio/toggle behavior.

Start with two reusable purpose-specific groups:
- Expand all / Collapse all.
- Save / Discard (reload), preserving existing dirty-state indications and unsaved-change protection.

Once these components exist, inventory existing individual-button usages and replace applicable usages with the shared groups, removing superseded local composition. Add the Expand all / Collapse all group to the text editor when the currently viewed document has foldable regions.

Keep this as one top-level task: the component work, usage inventory and adoption form one coherent change. The unresolved feedback about individual folding controls and expression-mode presentation is recorded separately and does not prescribe a redesign here.
properties.title: Add reusable icon button groups for expansion and save/reload actions
